rendered: Lead or lead oxide makes up almost 70%[1] of a lead-acid cell's mass, as the paper states: "of the mass of a lead-acid cell is lead or lead oxide[2]". The active cathode material of a Li-ion cell (NMC622 in the paper's example) accounts for around[3] 30% of the cell weight[4]. Dividing the first share by the second gives a ratio of 2.3[5] times, so the lead-acid share is about that many times the Li-ion cathode share.
